canonical_key_audit.interpretation: Every canonical-key/context mismatch is representation-only: legacy v5 canonical_key.hist separates multiple action tokens with ',' while context.history and the repo-native current key builder use '>'. Parsed position/action sequences are identical. Existing v5 is retained immutable; audits must normalize this legacy delimiter rather than treating these keys as distinct poker states.

runtime_equivalence_audit.interpretation: All actual runtime-equivalence collisions are pairs that differ only by context.free_check. Production exact matching omits free_check, so overlapping actions select the higher-support exact node.

reason: Including free_check in the exact predicate changes only 2 of 1,676 VALIDATION rows and has a small favorable point estimate, but the paired bootstrap 95% interval reaches 0. The pre-specified conservative promotion rule therefore does not establish a measurable held-out improvement; no finalist exists and locked TEST remains unconsumed.

repository_policy.legacy_v5_keys: do not rewrite; normalize ',' and '>' as equivalent history delimiters in diagnostics
repository_policy.future_repo_native_keys: keep the current '>' delimiter consistently between canonical_key and context.history
repository_policy.runtime_matcher: retain current v83/v5 exact predicate; do not add free_check without a future VALIDATION-qualified candidate
repository_policy.test_policy: locked TEST remains unused for this follow-up
